name: v6.0.9
body:
## Highlights

- **Write a cover letter with its own sender details.** Edit your name, email, phone and location without changing a resume, or choose **No resume** for a standalone letter. Your saved details carry through the preview, signature and downloads, and stay intact when refreshing the letter's design. [26a7aebfc](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/26a7aebfc), [4e448207b](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/4e448207b)
- **Compare offers without connecting an AI provider.** Enter offer terms yourself on web or mobile, including compensation, benefits and a response deadline. Missing details stay unknown so you can compare what you actually know. [5abf185fc](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/5abf185fc)

## Applications & Career

- Kept the interview Calendar available in phone browsers with an upcoming agenda, interview editing and links to application details. [e6234aafc](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/e6234aafc)
- Fixed interview times, day headings and calendar downloads to follow your account timezone. Calendars now follow the current account month until you browse elsewhere. [5c1672917](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/5c1672917), [e6234aafc](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/e6234aafc)
- Made **Apply** reflect recorded submissions while keeping your manual content-review checks separate. Closing a saved job no longer makes it appear submitted. [004ccd4d5](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/004ccd4d5)
- Added field-specific guidance for missing situation, action or result when saving a career story. [5b9c53b63](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/5b9c53b63)

## Resume Builder, Letters & Sharing

- Preserved independent sender headers in Word and OpenDocument cover-letter downloads, and clarified download actions. [1e0f39be1](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/1e0f39be1), [273893a0e](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/273893a0e)
- Fixed the PDF checker recognizing year ranges beside role titles. [bfc2d6b09](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/bfc2d6b09)
- Improved keyboard focus containment in the phone entry editor and updated browser tab titles after renaming saved documents. [cfe168cc4](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/cfe168cc4), [2188cf701](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/2188cf701)
- Corrected public-link summaries so password-protected resumes are described accurately. [d7cb0e10f](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/d7cb0e10f)

## Languages & Getting Started

- Added a direct homepage **Sign in** link, made the language selector easier to find, and honored explicit language choices on localized addresses. Removed the testing language from production choices. [aa7c27bc6](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/aa7c27bc6), [1238bb009](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/1238bb009), [fbef87bea](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/fbef87bea), [9b92695df](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/9b92695df)
- Updated guides and web and mobile translations for sender details, manual offers, story validation, interview scheduling and submission review. [26a7aebfc](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/26a7aebfc), [5abf185fc](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/5abf185fc), [5b9c53b63](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/5b9c53b63), [e6234aafc](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/e6234aafc), [004ccd4d5](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/004ccd4d5)

## AI & Self-Hosting

- Refreshed suggested models for new provider connections across web, mobile and assistant setup. Existing saved model choices stay unchanged. Thanks to @pcbeingused333. [ce467bcac](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/commit/ce467bcac)

No new database migrations or native mobile changes are included in this patch.

**Full Changelog**: [v6.0.8...v6.0.9](https://github.com/reactive-resume/reactive-resume/compare/v6.0.8...v6.0.9)
